name: Al Hussein warhead
source: 191 kg warhead, carried as payload_kg in the 'Al Hussein' booster file until 2026-09-03, when the booster library became stack-only; the number's own source is not recorded there. The vehicle does not separate its warhead (booster body_reenters = true): at run time the airframe mass and geometry are inherited from the last stage and the warhead rides as this object's added payload_kg. beta_kg_m2 = 0 means DERIVE from the airframe geometry at the reference Mach. mass_kg here is only the stage dry-mass placeholder (ignored for a body).
notes: [2026-09-03] Created by the payload migration. RECONSTRUCTION: geometry is the stage's; no warhead-specific dimensions are recorded. Ballistic (no lift).
